title: Dress code debate
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Who should decide what counts as appropriate clothing in a workplace or school?
Can the same dress code be fair to everyone?
Should religious or cultural clothing always be exempt from general dress rules?
Have dress codes become less important than they were twenty years ago?
What is one dress-code rule you think is reasonable and one you think is unnecessary?
